Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models (2206.04615v1) · paper method: BIG-bench task-definition files include a canary identifier intended to help exclude benchmark text from web-scraped training corpora and diagnose training-on-test use.

cohort4.claim.bigbench.contamination-canary

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported method; no experiment, dataset-record audit or formal proof was independently reproduced.
  • The mechanism does not establish exclusion by a particular model.
